svg.text: NADH gives a hydride (H⁻, two electrons) to the C=O: pyruvate is reduced, NADH is oxidized
Electron transfer between two substrates = oxidoreductase (EC 1). All dehydrogenases are
oxidoreductases. Lactate (C₃H₅O₃⁻) has 2 more H than pyruvate (C₃H₃O₃⁻), so not an isomer.
Regenerating NAD⁺ this way lets glycolysis continue without O₂.
